headline: Expensive air tickets hold back tourism. World Bank calls for opening the skies
summary: The World Bank recommends Kyrgyzstan review international aviation agreements and widen foreign airline access to its market. It says high airfares are holding back tourism.
why: Air access and fares shape tourism demand and transport costs, which affect airlines, hotels and tourism-linked businesses.
original_headline: Дорогие авиабилеты тормозят туризм. Всемирный банк призвал открыть небо
